title: Multi-tenant SaaS
goal: Show tenant-scoped users, billing, roles, and feature configuration with crow's-foot cardinality.

rubric.must: Tenant visibly contains one or more User records.
Tenant visibly holds subscriptions and Subscription visibly produces invoices.
Role visibly assigns users and Tenant visibly configures feature flags.
Tenant, User, Role, Subscription, Invoice, and Feature Flag are visible with readable fields.
Tenant-related foreign-key fields are visibly shown in User, Subscription, and Feature Flag.
Relationship endpoints visibly use crow's-foot cardinality marks.
